entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.595 of 2020 pending on the file of learned A.D.J.-cum-Special Court POCSO, Bhadrak, arising out of Bhandaripokhari P.S. Case No.61 of 2020 for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 342, 294,
506, 376(3), 376(2)(n) and 34 of I.P.C. read with Section 6 of POCSO Act 3.
4. Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the Case Diary in the meanwhile.
5. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioners shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case till the next date.
6. It is needless to say that the Petitioners shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency.
7. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
